path_reallocation.reason: The adopted workstream path hints name obsolete validator/src/fit, templates/repository-fit, and tests/fit locations; the live canonical implementation is validator/src/repository_fit.
path_reallocation.authority: Ultra root run-scoped reallocation only; no adopted contract row or public authority changes.
path_reallocation.semantic_scope: Production root authorization and durable mediation for the already accepted repository-fit apply kernel.

write_symbols: durable nonce and semantic-effect reservation ledger
lease.fixtures: Ephemeral isolated repositories and authority stores under /private/tmp only; no retained repository fixture is authorized.
lease.external_effects: Locked and offline local validation in one isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR plus isolated fixture writes only.

dependencies: accepted repository-fit apply mediator and rollback attribution
accepted successor public fit inspect, plan, and verify reads
root retains public catalog, dispatcher, trusted host-store policy, dependencies, claims, installation, and release
required_interfaces: Consume one exact PreparedFitApply and opaque request already bound to context, candidate, target, plan, and accepted-plan digest.
Issue non-forgeable bounded permits only through a sealed production authority using root-supplied trusted time and an explicit host-protected authority-store root.
Reserve nonce and semantic effect durably across processes before mutation and reconcile committed, rolled-back, rejected, interrupted, and ambiguous terminal states.
Open a production LocalEffects mutation lease only through the accepted authority and exact target scope; preserve descriptor confinement and Darwin-only support.
Return one bounded canonical machine outcome without secrets, nonce material, or absolute-path echo.
Keep help, version, parse, inspect, plan, and verify independent of authority initialization and recursively zero-write.

positive: fresh exact apply commits and verifies
partial dirty target preserves user bytes and applies only accepted mutations
idempotent repeat use performs no additional mutation
exact failure rolls back exact prior bytes
interrupted effect reconciles through the durable terminal ledger
negative: stale context, candidate, target, plan, accepted-plan digest, permit, expiry, and lease reject before effect
forged success and verify-as-apply cannot become terminal success
non-Apple construction and execution fail UnsupportedHost
secret, nonce, absolute path, and raw backend output canaries do not appear in public machine outcomes
race_and_mutation: two processes racing one nonce or semantic effect have exactly one reservation winner
ledger, key, lock, authority root, executable target, and terminal-record substitution fail closed
target mutation before and after reservation cannot escape the accepted plan
same-session rollback, stale-head replay, truncation, unknown rows, special files, symlinks, hardlinks, and ancestor replacement fail closed
zero_write: help, version, parse, inspect, plan, and verify leave both target and authority-store trees byte-identical
refused and unsupported paths create no ledger, key, lock, temp, telemetry, or target files
required_validation.commands: Use exact-file rustfmt, focused tests twice, dependency-closed repository-fit suites, production library check, authoritative typed receipt verification, mutation controls, and regular single-link artifact checks with 16 build jobs and 16 test threads.

prohibited_surfaces: live user repositories or host configuration
public command, manifest, registry, generated authority, migration, claim, acceptance, board, installation, release, and completion state
requested_root_changes: Root must select the trusted-time implementation and host-protected authority-store policy after independent review.
Root must wire fit apply through the sole public dispatcher under an exact WorkspaceWrite context after source acceptance.
Root must replace static apply-unavailable controls only when public effect behavior and zero-write read separation are candidate-bound.

worker_result.artifact_rule: Freeze every leased source, test, and generated receipt input except the self-excluded WorkerResult; reject missing, unknown, duplicate, overlapping, special, or changed rows.
worker_result.no_claim_statement: This worker does not claim readiness, release, or completion.

stop_rule: Stop on any need for public dispatcher, dependency, live-host, manifest, registry, migration, claim, external installation, destructive cleanup, or unspecified authority-store policy changes; request root wiring instead.
